info.title: Urja Meter Ops API
info.description: A clean, typed REST API in front of the legacy Urja Meter Ops portal. See PROTOCOL.md for how the portal works.

get.summary: Liveness plus freshness of the local snapshot

get.description: Served from a local snapshot of the portal's bulk export, so filters the portal cannot do are possible: status, make, phase, transformer, feeder, zone, and proximity (`lat`+`lng`+`radiusKm`, nearest first). If the snapshot cannot be loaded, plain `q`/`page` requests fall back to the portal's own search.

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Substring of meter id or serial number (case-insensitive)

parameters.name: lat
parameters.description: With lng: return meters within radiusKm, nearest first

get.summary: Meter consumption readings (resolution varies per meter)
get.description: The portal exposes cumulative kWh/kVAh registers at a resolution that differs per meter (e.g. 30-minute or daily; see summary.intervalMinutes). This endpoint also derives per-interval consumption, a summary and the power factor. Timestamps are ISO 8601; the portal gives local time without a zone, so we assume IST (+05:30).

intervalKwh.description: Energy used since the previous reading; null for the first reading or after a counter reset

intervalMinutes.description: Typical gap between readings in minutes (30 = half-hourly, 1440 = daily). Differs per meter.

counterResets.description: Times the cumulative register went backwards

skippedRows.description: Portal rows we could not parse and ignored
